title: Dichotomous
summary: DICHOTOMOUS, adjective [Gr., doubly, by pairs; to cut.] In botany, regularly dividing by pairs from top to bottom; as a dichotomous stem.

inlines.v: DICHOTOMOUS, adjective [Gr., doubly, by pairs; to cut.] In botany, regularly dividing by pairs from top to bottom; as a dichotomous stem.
